title: precheck refuses to accept a check that passes before the work as the only check of a goal clause
goal: precheck SP (and check) flags a goal clause whose only mapped check already passes on the base, even when the item's notes say the check pins behaviour, so a clause such as 'a failed link is not swallowed' gets a check that fails until the work is done
notes: SP-g2qseu5s retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
